body:
Prepare explicit disposable-runner lifecycle observations using a dedicated package suite that reuses Parties' real gateway, dependency and persistence assertions. The manual workflow retains all 15 existing isolated projects, package consumers and required platform-package integration before its qualification job; permissions remain contents-read with only the dedicated pull-reader secrets.

The controller recovers only exact receipt-issued same-job owners, probes finite same-job/cross-job/completed-owner admission, preserves first outcomes and expiry, exercises actual owner-scoped lock refusals/peer preservation/partial startup, and independently finalizes every sibling. Startup/execution readiness is uploaded before the parent operator cancels the exact run. Cancellation checks actual cancelled/Cancelled records, original admission and durable withdrawal, then immutable first fields through exact retry. Earlier product failure stays distinct; runner signal time is not represented as the GitHub API request time.

Persist the controller role and exact receipt recovery location before creating a child. A bounded test-controller pipe gate records the child’s actual PID, kernel birth and process group, and releases the unchanged public CLI only after durable parent bookkeeping. Constructor interruption and immediate bookkeeping faults recover through that intent; missing process proof or a released child without a receipt returns explicit unverified/non-success. Valid exact receipts still receive cleanup despite launch-record validation failure. Resume signaling/bookkeeping errors are classified without skipping exact down, every sibling remains independent, and artifact retention is attempted even if down also fails. Uncertain resume state remains non-success.

This is a **dependent draft**, based on actual main f7ef3e23561b58c3dca38c787258e5b2d5fa0d86 and preserving all incoming gitlinks. No accepted tool/workflow/Platform/catalog pin changes are included. Published 4.43.4/4.43.5 still have HXP020; a corrected normally published producer and coherent released Platform/reference adoption are prerequisites. The manual workflow is not registered or dispatched, and no hosted cleanup or candidate acceptance is claimed.

Validation:
- 27 focused local controller/workflow boundary tests pass, including actual parent SIGTERM during the Popen constructor, constructor/bookkeeping faults, durable release ordering and explicit unverified missing-receipt recovery; generator check, actionlint and whitespace check pass on the proposal base.
- Explicit LifecycleTests Release/package build on the preserved coherent 9c input passes with zero warnings/errors.
- Actual fixture invocation without a descriptor fails HXT106: one failure, zero skips, no services.
- Supported preparation on current-main inputs refuses before provisioning: HXW011 (Platform1080 lacks SemVer release tag), HXW009 (incoming Builds090 versus Platform269), and HXW007 (269 props absent in the shallow direct checkout). These first outcomes are retained; current-main native execution is not claimed.
- Exact title/commit pass owning locked commitlint21.2.4.

Operator gates, bounds, actual cancellation API receipt joins and evidence limitations are documented in docs/ci-lifecycle-qualification.md.
title: test(ci): qualify disposable owner lifecycle
head: ci/lifecycle-qualification-proposal
